name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2001 in Intrusions (ICS)
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK for ICS techniques for the Maroochy Shire sewerage control system attack of February to April 2000, whose sentence of 31 October 2001 falls in this study's year: the 12 techniques ATT&CK lists for campaign C0020, Maroochy Water Breach, with the Queensland Court of Appeal's judgment in R v Boden for the dated events. T1692.001 and T1692.002 supersede the revoked T0855 and T0856. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2001.md. Scores: 100 the ATT&CK object prints the id.
